stem: What can the reader tell about Pacy based on these details?

options.label: A
options.text: Pacy does not want to go anywhere without Melody.

options.label: B
options.text: Pacy thinks the whole family wants to visit her friend Melody.

options.label: C
options.text: Pacy thinks she should be able to decide where the family goes.

options.label: D
options.text: Pacy does not understand why her parents are taking the family to Taiwan.

visual_elements: "Yeah, but why does it have to be a trip to Taiwan?" I asked. "Why couldn't it be a trip to Hawaii? Or California? At least then we could've seen Melody!"
